description:
Vector illustration; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator, rebuilt in pure Rust

Vector illustration; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator, rebuilt in pure Rust.

- Familiar. Illustrator's layout, tools, menus, panels and shortcuts: the Pen, Direct Selection, Pathfinder, Smart Guides, Appearance, Swatches, Layers and more. You already know how to use it.
- Fast. Multithreaded SIMD rendering off the UI thread. 20,000 shapes render in about 27 ms at full retina resolution while the interface stays at 120 fps.
- Robust. Exact curve booleans (no "cannot perform operation"), unlimited undo via structural sharing, and property-tested file round trips.
- Open. A documented native format (.vectorcraft, JSON), first-class SVG, PDF (and PDF-compatible .ai) import and export, PNG/JPEG/WebP export, Export for Screens, and SVGZ, templates, GIF, TIFF and BMP on open.
- Agent-native. Every menu item, tool gesture, panel and dialog can be driven over a JSON control channel and an MCP server, so Claude and other agents can draw, edit and export the way a person does.
- Everywhere. One codebase for the desktop apps and the same UI in the browser.
Note
FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release. We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.
What's Changed
- Honor Preferences › Performance › Real-time Drawing and Editing during tool drags by @nrq6993-a11y in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2942
- Effects: stacked geometry effects keep to an anchor and line budget (#3578) by @odgrim in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3695

- Fix #2788: a dashed stroke with object opacity folds the opacity into its colour instead of compositing a canvas-wide layer by @Taha-Mahmoodi in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3697
- Regression tests for ten fixes merged without one by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3704

- i18n(ka): Relative Colorimetric is ფარდობითი კოლორიმეტრიული by @devius in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3706
- Render: a dashed brush stroke keeps the layered path for object opacity by @Taha-Mahmoodi in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3708
- Shape Builder: a split stroke keeps its path's direction and gradients by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3709
- Fix #3233: dimensions are redrawn in the colour mode after Document Color Mode and on open by @Taha-Mahmoodi in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3711
- G11 #722: keep imported PDF text boxes in place by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3715
- Honor Scale Artwork in Artboard Options resizing by @FractalEncrypt in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3714
- G11 #937: Shape Builder cuts art of thousands of segments with lines again by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3717
- Type: COLR colour fonts draw and export as vector art by @lehni in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3719
- Plug-ins: filters keep their settings in the document's foreign data (G17) by @KaboomFox in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3720
- G11 #885: Transform effect options (Transform Objects, Transform Patterns, Scale Strokes & Effects) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3726
- Render: a fill with a dashed brush stroke fades as a whole under object opacity by @Taha-Mahmoodi in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3725
- Fix #3233: an opened dimension whose label characters are off the colour mode is redrawn too by @Taha-Mahmoodi in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3727
- Fix: a path moved by its stroke or edge lands exactly on a ruler guide by @Taha-Mahmoodi in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3728
- G11 #834: bezier drag previews follow the pointer to the release by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3729
- Shape Builder: a Shift-drag draws a marquee and merges every region it reaches by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/3730
